messages:
maya: Quick sync re: auto-fallback UX. Need defaults that are safe and an easy audit path.

chris: Top-level UI: mode selector (soft/hard/sampled), traffic slider with canary presets (5/20/100), trigger summary, audit toggle. Advanced JSON behind a link.

linh: Important: include cooldown, hysteresis (min time between flips), and trigger window. Show per-region scoping.

product_ana: Audit must record decision_id, policy_version, trigger_snapshot, operator_id for manual overrides, and allow JSON/CSV export.

maya: Safety: require 2-step confirm for >50% changes or hard switchover. Add justification box that is recorded in the audit.

chris: Telemetry names: rollout.decision, rollout.replay, rollout.override, rollout.oscillation. Tag severity and retention class.

linh: Event skeleton we should emit: decision_id | policy_version | trigger_reason | trigger_values | action | route | trace_link. Keep raw metrics as blob link.

product_ana: UX: hover to show raw numbers and an "explain" view in plain english for support/PMs.

maya: Replay feature: timeline with decision markers; click -> open trace -> replay against stored metric slices in sandbox (no live traffic change) and mark match/mismatch.

ops-bot: Sample override curl for docs:
```bash
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/rollouts/override \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"decision_id":"auto-1809994444-xx","override_action":"route_canary","justify":"incident mitigation","manual":true}'
```

linh: Also show estimated cost delta for fallback (tokens & latency) so teams can tune fallback_pct.

chris: Add oscillation detector: if policy flips >3x in 10m, surface recommended action and pause auto-escalation until ack.

maya: Next steps: linch draft event schema PR, maya to write UX acceptance criteria, product_ana drafts customer notes, ops-bot creates RFC.

ops-bot: RFC created at https://go/redwood/rfcs/auto-fallback-audit-ui-2024 (draft). :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks all  closing thread.
